I’m a Data Scientist based in Vancouver, recently finished with my Master of Data Science at UBC. I thrive at the intersection of machine learning and messy, real-world data. Whether I’m wrangling millions of product reviews, fusing clinical imaging with EHR data, or building tools to make data cleaning less of a headache, I am always focused on the practical application of my work. Above all, I believe in building models that are transparent, reproducible, and ready for the real world.
